LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_SickWorkOn: {PAWN_nameDef} has come down with {ILLNESS}, caught from {OTHER}, who worked on sick after the petition to rest was let go. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_SickWorkOn_2: {OTHER} kept working with it, and {PAWN_nameDef}, who worked beside {OTHER} longest, has {ILLNESS} now. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_GateSick: {PAWN_nameDef} has come down with {ILLNESS}, caught from {OTHER}, who came to the gate from the sick towns. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_GateSick_2: The plague in the region came to the gate with {OTHER}, and {PAWN_nameDef}, who was nearest them longest, has {ILLNESS}. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_CourierSick: {PAWN_nameDef} has come down with {ILLNESS}, caught from {OTHER}, the courier from the sick towns. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_CourierSick_2: {OTHER} brought the region's sickness along with the goods, and {PAWN_nameDef}, who unloaded beside {OTHER}, has {ILLNESS}. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_CampFever: {PAWN_nameDef} has come down with {ILLNESS}, caught at the camp's fire from {OTHER}, who lay ill there. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_CampFever_2: All those evenings at the camp's fire beside {OTHER} have left {PAWN_nameDef} with {ILLNESS}. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_PatientIll: {PAWN_nameDef} has come down with {ILLNESS}, caught from {OTHER}, the patient who slept in the same room. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_PatientIll_2: {OTHER} came for the doctor and left {ILLNESS} behind: {PAWN_nameDef} shared the room with {OTHER} and has it now. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_BadBatch: {PAWN_nameDef} woke queasy with {ILLNESS}: the dose from {OTHER}'s case was a bad batch. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_BadBatch_2: {OTHER}'s tonic had turned in the bottle, and {PAWN_nameDef} has {ILLNESS} this morning for it. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_PetitionLapse: Let go unheeded while something catching goes round, the sick work on, and it reaches one more of the colony.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_PatientTale_TB: deep cough that sounds like tuberculosis
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_PatientTale_Cholera: stomach sickness that looks like cholera
LanguageData.CC_Impact_GateSickness: Travelers from the sick towns may carry it in, to whoever trades or talks with them longest
LanguageData.CC_Impact_CampFeverStops: Seen to, {0}'s fever won't pass to whoever sits at their fire
LanguageData.CC_Impact_PatientIll: {0} carries something catching, and whoever of ours sleeps in the same room may catch it
LanguageData.CC_Impact_PatientIllBrief: a room of their own keeps it from us
LanguageData.CC_Impact_BadBatch: Now and then a healer's batch has turned, and a few who take it are the worse for it next morning
LanguageData.CC_Impact_BadBatchBrief: a bad batch now and then
LanguageData.CC_Impact_BatchLooked: {0} looks the batch over first, and a bad one would be caught
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_GutWorms: The worms {PAWN_nameDef} was left to carry have taken hold, and it is {ILLNESS} now, which needs a doctor.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_GutWorms_2: Nobody saw to {PAWN_nameDef}'s worms, and they have grown into {ILLNESS}.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_Malaria: One of the bites {PAWN_nameDef} was left with carried {ILLNESS}: this is a malaria country.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_Malaria_2: {PAWN_nameDef}'s untended bites have turned into a shaking fever: {ILLNESS}.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_DirtyWater_2: The water here is drunk as it comes, and {PAWN_nameDef} has {ILLNESS} for it. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_GateCold: Hours waiting at the gate in the frost have given {PAWN_nameDef} {ILLNESS}. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_GateCold_2: {PAWN_nameDef} stood at the gate in the bitter cold waiting for the others, and has {ILLNESS} for it. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_GateColdLetter: It is a hard frost out at the gate, and a long wait there in it can bring frostnip or chilblains to those standing in it.
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_WatchCold: A night on the walls in the frost has given {PAWN_nameDef} {ILLNESS}. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_WatchCold_2: {PAWN_nameDef} kept the watch through a bitter night and has {ILLNESS} for it. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_RainLover: {PAWN_nameDef} stood out in the rain again, soaked through, and has {ILLNESS} for it. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_RainLover_2: All that standing in the rain has caught up with {PAWN_nameDef}: {ILLNESS}. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_SnowLover: {PAWN_nameDef} stayed out in the falling snow far too long in the bitter cold, and has {ILLNESS}. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_SnowLover_2: The snow {PAWN_nameDef} loves so much has nipped {PAWN_possessive} fingers and cheeks: {ILLNESS}. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_Impact_WatchCold: A long watch in this frost can bring frostnip to one without warm clothes, and one alone outside the walls may draw a predator
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_SleepwalkFrost: {PAWN_nameDef} walked out into the frost in {PAWN_possessive} sleep and has {ILLNESS} for it. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_SleepwalkFrost_2: A sleepwalk across the frozen yard has left {PAWN_nameDef} with {ILLNESS}. {NOTE}
LanguageData.CC_HarmFive_ForecastMissed: The forecast missed: on {DATE} a frost of {TEMP}, colder than the land's reckoning, caught the crop this field was sown for.
